question: What is the minimum age requirement for a candidate to be elected as a member of the Panchayat Samiti?
solution:
The correct answer is __**21 years**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The minimum age requirement for a candidate to be elected as a member of the Panchayat Samiti is **21 years**.
 
• The Panchayat Samiti is a rural local government body at the intermediate level in the Panchayati Raj system.
 
• It works for the villages of the tehsil or taluka that together are called a development block.
 
• The Panchayat Samiti is a link between the Gram Panchayat (village council) and the Zila Parishad (district board).
 
• It administers rural development activities and implements schemes for agriculture, rural development, and social welfare.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Panchayati Raj system was introduced in India to decentralize power to the grassroots level.
 
• It was recommended by the Balwant Rai Mehta Committee in 1957 and was constitutionalized through the 73rd Amendment Act of 1992.
 
• The Act provides a three-tier system of Panchayati Raj in every state, namely the Gram Panchayat at the village level, the Panchayat Samiti at the intermediate level, and the Zila Parishad at the district level.
 
• To ensure that the Panchayati Raj institutions function effectively, the Act mandates regular elections every five years.
 
• The Act also provides for the reservation of seats for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and women to promote inclusive governance.
